source.method: Previously captured high-fidelity get_design_context response and screenshot

implementationDecisions: The component names are a CSS API for the visual rules; the inspected Figma file has no separate Card component family.
Explicit outer/inner geometry remains 32/16 px at mobile sizes, with a 16 px gap and direct text margins reset to avoid doubling the gap.
Legacy af-card without geometry modifiers retains its previous block layout, neutral 1 px border and 20 px mobile padding/radius; these are existing Framework choices.
A filled surface uses inherited white text. Nested explicit white cards reset to primary text; nested controls keep their own component colors. Inverse CTAs are explicit.
Forced colors replace fill/elevation with a visible system border and remove the shadow.
No new serialized surface values, runtime JavaScript, renderer wrappers or entry points are introduced. Existing af-surface--plain/card renderer flags remain distinct.
